results.title: Modi's unmissable tricolour gesture
results.description: During the Quad Leaders’ Summit photo-op in Manila on the sidelines of the ASEAN Summit, PM Narendra Modi picked up an Indian flag marker from the floor, prompting US President Donald Trump to say, “Save it.”
